title: Removal of "unable to deliver to buyer address" as a cancellation reason in ID, VN, TH, SG, PH markets
breadcrumb: Removal of "unable to deliver to buyer address" as a cancellation reason in ID, VN, TH, SG, PH markets
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2023-12-22
html:
What is changing?

Starting March 1, 2024, sellers will no longer be able to use "unable to deliver to buyer address" as a reason for canceling orders. This change is intended to encourage sellers to provide more solid reasons for cancellations.

Which markets are affected?

This update affects local sellers in ID, SG, TH, VN, and PH markets

Who is affected?

Developers who have integrated the Cancel Order endpoint into their apps are impacted by this change.

What action is required?

If your app integration includes "unable to deliver to buyer address" as a cancellation reason for seller-initiated cancellations, you need to remove this option from your app before March 1, 2024.
